focus: Sweep the documentation and generated surface outside the doctor folder: the advisor's INSTALL-GUIDE, README, SKILL.md, references, feature catalog and manual testing playbook, INSTALL-SKILLED.md, .env.example and the ENV references, the changelog files, graph-metadata trigger phrases, and the generated routing artifacts
noveltyJustification: 11 of 15 findings were fully new and 4 partially new (they extend files the starting inventory already named, or are a recommendation built on new counts).
keyQuestions: Which docs, changelogs, feature catalogs, manual testing playbooks, READMEs, env references, graph-metadata trigger phrases and generated or compiled routing artifacts carry Ollama or semantic-lane remnants?
answeredQuestions: Which docs, changelogs, feature catalogs, manual testing playbooks, READMEs, env references, graph-metadata trigger phrases and generated or compiled routing artifacts carry Ollama or semantic-lane remnants?
ruledOut: Grepping the raw trigger-index.json as a residue signal: 981 of its 989 matching paths are under specs/, so it matches for as long as historical packets exist.

Treating the strict identifier pattern as sufficient: 66 files, including the advisor SKILL.md, ROUTER.md and graph-metadata.json, match only the prose vocabulary (five-lane, vector refresh, semantic lane).
Runtime mirror folders as a separate doc surface: the tracked-file sweep found no match outside .skilled/, .github/, README.md, INSTALL-SKILLED.md and .env.example.
Other skills graph-metadata.json trigger phrases: only the advisor's own file matches.

Treating cli-codex --oss, mcp-figma, sk-design's vector store, the deep-loop semantic_shadow_only field, sk-create-benchmark case studies, cite-drift redirects and sk-code sqlite-vec examples as remnants: they describe other systems.

label: The strict identifier pattern matches 262 tracked files outside specs/ and the doctor folder, 93 of them docs or data files outside test folders. A second prose pattern (five-lane, vector refresh, semantic lane, the npm dependency name) adds 66 files the first one misses, including the advisor's own SKILL.md, ROUTER.md and graph-metadata.json. A residue check built on the strict pattern alone would pass with those still in place.

Eleven doc files are deleted whole: the advisor catalog entries background-vector-refresh.md and command-meaning-matching.md, three advisor embedder READMEs (lib/embedders, lib/embedders/adapters, tests/embedders), spec-kit references/memory/embedder-pluggability.md, the three shared/embeddings READMEs and two spec-kit tests/embedders READMEs. Each has inbound links: feature-catalog.md 26 (count 8 to 7), 29 (count 10 to 9), 54 and 102; spec-kit ROUTER.md 46 and 243; leaf-manifest and leaf-aliases rows in both skills; INSTALL-GUIDE 354 and 387; memory-system.md 256. The router line and leaf files change in the same commit as each deletion.

Install docs: INSTALL-SKILLED.md loses the section Meaning Matching For Commands (86 to 98), install order row 5 (157), the semantic_lane_off troubleshooting row (342) and the words its embedder (351). Advisor INSTALL-GUIDE.md loses section 12 (275 to 378), so sections 13 and 14 renumber, plus the prerequisites bullet at 54 and the related-resources row at 387. INSTALL-GUIDE.md 105 is a package check that imports dist/.../lanes/semantic-shadow.js and fails once the lane file is deleted, so it needs a replacement import. Root README.md 204 and 26 (5-lane fusion) change.

Advisor identity files: README.md 38, 46, 48, 90, 92, 113; ARCHITECTURE.md 22, 79, 126, 130, 160; SKILL.md 20 (keyword semantic-lane) and 111 (includeEmbeddingsHealth and includeSemanticHealth); ROUTER.md 42 and 175 (keyword five-lane); graph-metadata.json trigger phrases at 106, 107, 114 and 115 (vector coverage, semantic lane, background vector refresh, vector refresh). The phrases are copied into the tracked export runtime/scripts/skill-graph.json and each user's skill-graph.sqlite. No other graph-metadata.json or description.json outside specs/ matches.

The lane count changes from five to four in 45 tracked files outside specs/. Three file names carry it: feature-catalog/scorer-fusion/five-lane-fusion.md, manual-testing-playbook/scorer-fusion/five-lane-fusion.md and runtime/stress-test/skill-advisor/five-lane-fusion-stress.vitest.ts. Renaming touches about a dozen inbound links and four leaf-file rows; keeping the names leaves files called five-lane that describe four. Open decision.

Six advisor references are edited in place: advisor-scorer.md 55, 65, 79, 81, 83; lane-weight-tuning.md 58; validation-baselines.md 147; freshness-contract.md 146; db-path-policy.md 96 and 97 (the MEMORY_DB_PATH rationale exists only for shared/embeddings/factory.ts); daemon-lease-contract.md 138 (matched words not read).

Nine advisor feature catalog files are edited in place: advisor-status.md 31, 49, 50, 59; lifecycle.md 28; watcher.md 22; age-haircut.md 22; ablation.md 40; attribution.md 37; doctor-command-routing.md 31; five-lane-fusion.md 3, 30, 32, 59; weights-config.md 22, 24.

Eight manual testing playbook scenarios are edited and none is deleted: daemon-lifecycle-shutdown.md 107; watcher-narrow-scope.md 87; age-haircut.md 3, 19, 26, 56; native-status-transitions.md 77; degraded-daemon.md 61, 62, 115, 181; ablation.md 58, 59; five-lane-fusion.md 3, 21, 28, 63, 64, 65, 76, 77; lane-attribution.md 58, 59, 70, 104. Four lines are expected-output JSON listing semantic_shadow 0, so a tester sees a mismatch after removal unless they change.

Env references: .env.example section 7 from 228 (keys at 232 to 250) plus 95, 96, 100, 409 and 411; spec-kit ENV-REFERENCE.md section 6 from 293 with the HF model server subsection at 327, the cascade probe section at 447, the quick start at 593, rows 187, 188, 391, 392, 394, 395, 396; environment-variables.md 38, 59 to 66, 72, 92, 133, 136; spec-kit ARCHITECTURE.md 160 and 200; shared/README.md ten lines. Whether the RSS watchdog subsection at ENV-REFERENCE 347 survives depends on what the launcher still supervises, which was not read.

Outside the two skills: .skilled/bin/README.md (10 lines) and bin/lib/README.md (8 lines) describe the model server; orphan-mcp-sweeper.sh classifies it at 216 and 504 and preserves a user's ollama processes at 491 (keep or remove is an open decision); the create-command workflow says the daemon embeds a new command when Ollama is reachable (auto 472, confirm 484, presentation 168); skill-advisor-stress.yml 49 and 50 set the refresh opt-out. The advisor's scripts/doctor.sh requires @huggingface/transformers to import (58) and exits 26 otherwise (16), so dropping the dependency at runtime/package.json 20 without editing the script fails the health script on every machine.

Generated artifacts and owners: command-bridges.generated.json is the output of derive-command-bridges.cjs (regenerate); trigger-index.json comes from generate-trigger-index.mjs over CORPUS_ROOTS (regenerate); runtime/scripts/skill-graph.json is a tracked diagnostic export (regenerate); sk-doc baseline-readme-verdicts.json is rebuilt by test_readme_verdict_parity.py --write and durable-directory-manifest.json by test_readme_manifest.py; cite-drift-labels.jsonl rows 14 and 36 target semantic-shadow.ts and are written only by cite-drift-scan.mjs --draw; scorer-eval-baseline.json 9 records the reader-less env key; three lockfiles regenerate. The writer of the advisor and spec-kit leaf-manifest.json and leaf-aliases.json was not found.

Three open checks settled. scoring-compatibility.json is a generator input (read at COMPATIBILITY_PATH 26, validated at 781 and 920, never written), so its four embedder lines at 266, 268, 611, 613 are hand-removed before regenerating. embeddingText has one production reader, skill-graph-db.ts 784 to 810, 1416, 1743 and 1763, all on the vector path, so the field and the generator code at 1353 go with the lane and the drift-guard test changes at 24, 227 and 397. advisor_status stays declared on _routes.yaml 122, 145, 167 and 392; only the embedder route at 240 passes the semantic-health flag.

Twenty-three changelog files mention the lane: six global on the strict pattern (v3.4.0.0, v3.5.0.0, v3.5.0.3, v4.0.0.0, v4.1.0.0, v4.2.0.0), five advisor, four spec-kit, the doctor skill's v1.1.7.0 and sk-doc's v1.6.0.0, plus ten more on the prose pattern. No rule in sk-create-changelog, the repo rules or the changelog README says whether a released entry may be rewritten. This conflicts with the topic's zero-remnants wording and is an operator decision: rewrite, or exclude changelog folders from the residue check by path. Changelogs also feed the trigger index.

Matches that are not remnants and belong on the residue check's allowlist: cli-codex --oss Ollama mode (cli-reference.md 105, 173, 549; providers-and-models.md 64), mcp-figma figma-cli-reference.md 92, sk-design's own vector store (seven files), the deep-loop semantic_shadow_only field at community-projection.ts 747, sk-create-benchmark case studies, the sk-create-changelog worked example at 103, cite-drift-redirects.json spec path names, and sk-code sqlite-vec typing examples. mcp-click-up auto-note.md 19 is unclassified.

Exclusion rule for the residue check: 2,366 tracked files under specs/ match, and the trigger index holds 20,249 paths of which 16,869 are under specs/. 989 index paths match, 8 outside specs/ (all deleted in this removal); 334 phrases match, about 29 resolving outside specs/ (approximate). Recommended: scan tracked files with specs/ excluded by path, treat changelog folders per the operator decision, allowlist the non-remnant files by path, use both patterns, and for the trigger index regenerate it and assert no matching phrase resolves outside the excluded set instead of grepping the raw file.
system-deep-loop/package-lock.json 21 lists @huggingface/transformers under the shared package, which shared/package.json does not declare; the lockfile is already stale.
